description: Trim audio. Cut a fragment out of a recording by timecodes. By default the stream is copied, so the cut costs no quality. Accepts audio/*, .m4a, .opus, .aac; up to 200 MB per file.

end.description: End. Leave empty to cut to the end of the recording

fade.description: Fade in and out at the edges. Requires re-encoding

outputDir.description: Where to put the results. Defaults to the folder each source file came from. Existing files are never overwritten.

paths.description: Paths to the files to process, absolute or relative to the working directory.

reencode.description: Re-encode for an exact cut. Slower, and quality drops slightly

name: audio_trim
